Name a study's working dataset without registering it

Source: R/declare_data.R
declare_data.Rd

Writes the study dataset's contract, built: and key:, to _study.yml, and an empty manifest.yaml when the study has none. It registers no version. The dataset is then known but has no registered version, so every read of it is a working read: allowed in the console and in a draft render, refused in a final one. Register it with update_manifest() when it is ready.

Usage

declare_data(root = getwd(), built, key = NULL)

Arguments

root

The study root.

built

The working file's name in the datasets folder, with its extension.

key

Columns that make a row unique, or NULL to leave key: unset.

Value

TRUE, invisibly, when the contract was written, or a key was added to a declaration that had none; FALSE, invisibly, when built was already declared. Stops when the study already declares a different file or a different key.

Details

A new study's first build needs this before any job can read it, because read_built() finds the file through the contract. The empty manifest is there because the templates call verify_manifest() before reading data, and that stops on a missing file. An existing manifest is left untouched. The bd template calls this on its first render with REGISTER = FALSE.

Examples

root <- file.path(tempdir(), "declare-example")
suppressMessages(study_setup(root, "Example", 1L, renv = FALSE))
#> Study: /tmp/RtmphMdbiC/declare-example
#> 
#> [x] _study.yml — study: Example
#> [ ] renv.lock — no renv.lock; run renv::init() in the study project
#> [ ] manifest.yaml — no manifest.yaml; register_data() creates it
#> [ ] dataset — no default dataset registered; run register_data()
#> [ ] provenance — no .qmd/.Rmd sources found; 0 sidecars
#> 
#> 0 .R  |  0 .qmd/.Rmd  |  0 .sas  |  0 provenance sidecars
saveRDS(data.frame(ccfid = 1:3), file.path(study_dir("datasets", root), "study_cohort.rds"))
declare_data(root, built = "study_cohort.rds", key = "ccfid")
unlink(root, recursive = TRUE)
